title: Finn M. W. Caspersen and Household International Professor of Law and Economics
bio: Louis Kaplow is Finn M.W. Caspersen and Household International Professor of Law and Economics at Harvard Law School, a Research Associate at the National Bureau of Economic Research, and a Fellow of the American Academy of Arts and Sciences. He has a Ph.D. in economics and a J.D. from Harvard University. He has published widely […]
